{{Quote|Does anyone have any oil? I'm a little stiff...|A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]|<ref name="Deadly Allies">{{TCWComicCite|6.51|Deadly Allies}}</ref>}}
'''Oil''' was a slippery substance used as a lubricant for mechanical devices as well as for medicine, nourishment, and cooking. [[Droid/Legends|Droids]] were often given [[Oil bath/Legends|oil baths]] to remove contaminants from their mechanical parts. At times, oil could get clogged in a droid's [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]]. [[Petroleum]] was a type of oil that was used in the processing of [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]].

On [[Drexel/Legends|Drexel]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Quarg]]'s band of marooned [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] procured oil by extracting it from the planet's native [[Fish/Legends|fish]] population. On [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]], the [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] colonists extracted oils from enormous seedpods for use as nourishment and medicine.<ref name="SWE Lurmen">{{SWE|groups|lurmen|Lurmen}}</ref>

Types of oils used in cooking included [[Aola]], [[Foyvè oil]], [[Groundnut oil]], [[Levsh oil]], [[Pepper oil]], and [[Zaffa oil/Legends|Zaffa oil]].

[[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], possessed an [[orange]] cloak in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] that was covered in some type of oil.
